app.title: HIS Simulator
app.subtitle: A simulated hospital information system for CareLoop

banner.simulated: Simulated data only. Every patient, staff member and message shown here is synthetic.

placeholder.notice: This screen is a placeholder. It has not been built yet.

scenarioRunner.title: Scenario runner
scenarioRunner.description: Replays the HIS steps of a scripted, simulated scenario against CareLoop.
scenarioRunner.boundary: Only HIS events are replayed here. Finished replay is not proof of completed care; patient behaviour and full journey assertions belong to WS8/WS10. Shared happy-path evidence still includes a placeholder.
scenarioRunner.expectations: Declared expectations (not verified by this runner)
scenarioRunner.cohortDeferred: Cohort expansion is deferred to WS10 and cannot be started.
scenarioRunner.pacing: Real seconds per scenario hour (blank uses configuration)
scenarioRunner.runKey: Stable replay key (optional; reuse deduplicates source events)

staffInbox.title: Staff inbox
staffInbox.description: What CareLoop has told the hospital system about cases: escalations, handoffs, call requests and handoff summaries. Direct staff notices go by text message or email and are shown in the messaging simulator. Receiving an item is not an acknowledgement.
staffInbox.recipient: Recipient identifier or queue (blank shows all)

fhirLog.title: FHIR message log
fhirLog.description: Every simulated FHIR message this simulator has sent to CareLoop or received from it.

clinicianActions.title: Act as clinician
clinicianActions.description: Manually perform the actions a person would take in the hospital system. The simulator never decides urgency or closure itself.
clinicianActions.codes: Enter clinical codes from the configured pathway, without inventing values. Each submission represents an explicit human action in the synthetic HIS.
clinicianActions.noCases: No source cases yet. Start a scenario to send a screening result first.
clinicianActions.handoffSummaryNote: Read-only: exactly the text a person approved in CareLoop and CareLoop sent to this HIS.
clinicianActions.followUpReport: Send as a follow-up DiagnosticReport instead of Procedure
clinicianActions.proposedRole: Proposed owner's role (required with a proposed owner)
clinicianActions.receivingFacility: Synthetic receiving or proposed owner's facility (required with a proposed owner)
clinicianActions.caregiver: Synthetic caregiver contact (required for active consent)

closureReasons.on-surveillance: On surveillance (needs a next surveillance date)

clinicianActions.evidenceChecked: I have checked the evidence above
clinicianActions.taskUnknown: CareLoop's actual case Task has not arrived through FHIR yet. Closure will be refused until it is known.
clinicianActions.inspectLog: Inspect the FHIR message log for exact request and response bodies.

common.httpError: Simulator request failed (HTTP {{status}}). Inspect the server log and retry.
common.networkError: The simulator request could not be completed. Check connectivity and retry.
